rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for showing anger about something wrong or unfair.

example.english: I was indignant about the unfair way they treated the new colleague.
example.traditional: 佢哋咁樣蝦個新同事，我真係氣憤嘅。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gam3 joeng6 haa4 go3 san1 tung4 si6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hei3 fan5 ge3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on resentment or not accepting unfair treatment.

example.english: They were indignant that the company had unfairly docked their pay.
example.traditional: 公司無啦啦扣佢人工，佢心裏好不忿嘅。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 mou4 laa4 laa1 kau3 keoi5 jan4 gung1 keoi5 sam1 leoi5 hou2 bat1 fan5 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a strongly indignant reaction in formal or written contexts.

example.english: The public was indignant about the arrangement, and the anger continued to grow online.
example.traditional: 市民對有關安排感到憤慨嘅情緒，喺網上持續升溫。
example.jyutping: si5 man4 deoi3 jau5 gwaan1 on1 paai4 gam2 dou3 fan5 koi3 ge3 cing4 seoi5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 ci4 zuk6 sing1 wan1
